name: serif
description: A minimalist, typography-first FSE (Full Site Editing) theme tailored for writers, journalists, and designers.

scripts.makepot: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=/var/www/html/wp-content/themes/Serif wp i18n make-pot . languages/serif.pot --ignore-domain
scripts.update-po: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=/var/www/html/wp-content/themes/Serif wp i18n update-po languages/serif.pot languages/
scripts.makemo: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=/var/www/html/wp-content/themes/Serif wp i18n make-mo languages/
scripts.bundle: mkdir -p build && bestzip build/serif.zip assets/css/ inc/ functions.php style.css screenshot.png
